app.subtitle: High School Entrance Interview Practice for Foreign Students

mode_select.title: Mode Select
mode_select.practice_desc: A one-on-one practice mode. You will receive advice from Professor Owl after each answer.
mode_select.real_desc: Answer 5 questions non-stop, just like the actual exam. There is no advice along the way.
mode_select.vocab_desc: Check the meanings and readings of important words and phrases frequently used in interviews.
mode_select.ordering_desc: Learn Japanese interview manners by putting them in the correct order.

ordering.title: Action Ordering Mode
ordering.lead: Choose the cards above and place them in the slots 1-4 below in the correct order.
ordering.alert_fill_all: Please place cards in all slots.
ordering.incorrect_msg: Let's think again. The order seems to be wrong.
ordering.step_2: 2. Click the slot where you want to place it
ordering.step_3: 3. Click the check button once all items are placed
ordering.note_1: • You can return an image to the choices by clicking it again in the slot
ordering.note_2: • Click the reset button to return all items to the choices

interview.ready_msg: When you are ready, click "Start Voice Dialogue".

vocab.title: Vocabulary Mode
vocab.lead: Click on words frequently used in interviews to check their meanings and readings.
